_about: paper_acquire project config. `python -m paper_acquire --project <dir> init` copies this file to <dir>/config.json. Fill contact_email and privacy_markers before the first run. API keys belong in environment variables, never in this file.
_contact_email: Sent to OpenAlex, Unpaywall and Crossref as the polite-pool contact, as those services ask.
_privacy_markers: Strings the outbound privacy gate scans every produced zip for (your name, e-mail, institution). The list itself never leaves the machine.
_browser_enabled: Switch to true only after your library knows about rate-limited automated retrieval of entitled content and does not object; see RESPONSIBLE_USE.md.
_browser_driver: playwright (default) or patchright; read RESPONSIBLE_USE.md before choosing patchright.
_browser_channel: chrome or msedge. Edge ignores the download-PDFs setting when it is the system PDF reader; the start-up self-test reports it.
_browser_login_gate: true: the run opens the browser and waits until you have logged in through your institution.
_browser_trace: true: each browser attempt appends event classes and timings (no URLs or titles) to the day folder.
_browser_skip_publishers: Publisher tokens (e.g. "tandf", "emerald") whose content should not be retrieved automatically; those records go to your manual list instead.
_publisher_entitlement: Declare publishers you have no subscription to, e.g. {"wiley": "no_sso_entitlement"}; the browser step then skips them honestly.
